title: Cure Deposit Schedule for Repeated Late Fees
content:
A cure payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts also carries a cure deposit, applied to principal, that follows the late fees assessed on the contract when fewer than 12 whole months separate their assessment date from the payment date.

| Late fees in the 12-month window | Cure deposit included in the cure payment |
|---|---|
| three or more | repeat-lateness cure deposit: 25.00 |
| exactly two | second-lateness cure deposit: 10.00 |
| one or none | no deposit |

The deposit is a flat dollar amount and goes to principal.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, payment on 2026-12-03)

| Late fee assessment date | Whole months before the payment | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-12-04 | 11 | yes |
| 2025-12-03 | 12 | no |

## Hypothetical readings

- Late fees assessed in February, June and October of the same year, with a payment in November: three in the window, deposit 25.00.
- Two late fees in the window: 10.00.
- One late fee in the window, and an older one 14 whole months back: one counts, no deposit.
